name: Fury of the Land
summary: The Library in Ironforge seeks magical works for its collection. Your findings help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Place for Knowledge
sections.body: In Ironforge's Library, you are asked to bring magical works that may benefit its collection. The librarian welcomes what you have found, and invites you to bring more if you discover it.

faq.answer: The Library seeks magical works that may benefit its collection.

faq.q: Where should I bring magical works?
faq.answer: Bring them to the librarian in the Library in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why are they collecting magical works?
faq.answer: The librarian says each contribution expands their knowledge.

attribution: In-game quest text: Fury of the Land
